title: Covered Seat Points on Network and Server Order Cancellation Fees
content:
Seat points come off the infrastructure fee percentage, the fee percentage charged on a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order, by the seats currently covered on the client's active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement: **1.5 points** for at least **25** seats, **0.5 points** for at least **10** and fewer than 25 seats, and none for fewer seats or no active ClearPath agreement.

The seat count is the one currently on the client's ClearPath agreement whose status is active.

| Seats currently covered | Points off |
|---|---|
| 9 or fewer | none |
| 10 | 0.5 |
| 24 | 0.5 |
| 25 | 1.5 |
| 25 or more | 1.5 |
| no active agreement | none |
